title: There is no negative zero
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: Counting back from the end starts at -1, not -0, because -0 and 0 are the same number. So `[-0]` quietly gives you the FIRST element — the one place where reaching for the end lands you at the start.
